### User interactions

#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Save audio | Open or close the format menu. |
| MP3 / OGG / WAV | Choose an available format, then a filename, and save the audio. For an audio player, only the current source’s format is shown; unavailable formats are omitted. A check marks the current format. |
| Outside the menu | Close the menu. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between controls. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused control or format. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the menu. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User help for the component under the pointer, falling back to focus. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
